title: Rashod Bateman, Ronnie Stanley say new Ravens coaching staff values details more than previous one

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rashod Bateman, Ronnie Stanley say new Ravens coaching staff values details more than previous one
sources.description: The Ravens are nearing the end of their first offseason under head coach Jesse Minter and a pair of the team's veterans have identified areas they believe have improved since John Harbaugh's departure at the end of last season.
